hero.title: Wedding Violin Services
hero.subtitle: Central Coast Wedding Violinist
hero.description: Live violin for your wedding day on California's Central Coast. From a solo violinist for your ceremony to a full band, sound system and DJ for your reception, I'll take care of the music from start to finish.

proposal.title: Planning a Proposal?
proposal.description: Thinking about popping the question? Make it especially romantic by adding solo violin or violin-guitar duo! Hatch a plan, name the place, and we can come out at the perfect moment to surprise your special someone with an unforgettable ambiance. Choose 3 songs from our list or make some custom requests.

items.title: Service Area
items.description: Proudly serving San Luis Obispo County, the Central Coast, and beyond. Travel is free within San Luis Obispo County, and I'm happy to travel farther for your wedding. See travel fees below.

items.title: Setup & Sound Check
items.description: I arrive early to ensure everything is perfect before your guests arrive.

items.title: Custom Song Requests
items.description: Have a special song in mind? Custom requests are welcome with advance notice.

items.title: Outdoor Weddings
items.description: Weather contingency plans available. I'm experienced with outdoor venue setups.

travelFees.title: Travel Fees
travelFees.description: I'm based in San Luis Obispo and love playing all over the Central Coast.

tiers.area: Neighboring areas, about 1.5 hours or less
tiers.examples: Northern Santa Barbara County (Santa Maria, Los Alamos, Los Olivos, Santa Ynez Valley), southern Monterey County, Big Sur coast

tiers.fee: Quoted case by case, including lodging

travelFees.note: Travel fees are per booking, the same for solo violin or the duo.
